errors.text: The hypothesis identifies Au and Pt as the surface-segregating species, whereas the target mechanism specifically involves low-surface-energy Au and Cu forming the surface-enriched layer.

It attributes disappearance of the smallest particles primarily to Ostwald ripening and transfer of material to larger particles, while the target reports Au/Cu surface melting and evaporation, including an overall particle-size reduction.
It predicts Au/Pt-rich versus Co/Ni/Cu-rich phase separation but omits the observed Au/Cu shell and its evaporation near 973 K.
